notes: CVM dairy-farm letter citing (1) adulteration of a food-producing animal sold for slaughter due to a sulfadimethoxine tissue-residue violation and inadequate treatment records, and (2) adulteration of new animal drugs via extralabel use of Sulfadimethoxine Injection 40% and flunixin meglumine injection outside veterinary-prescription/label directions (21 CFR 530). Classified 'other' per the dejong-family-dairy precedent: this is a farm-level residue/extralabel-use adulteration case, not CGMP/compounding/device/food_supplement/biologics/unapproved-marketing. Both drug names appear partly in clear text (formulation/generic name unredacted, only a trailing (b)(4) -- likely brand name or exact dose -- redacted), so product_redacted is false and both are listed as products, unlike dejong where the drug name was fully redacted.
